hooks.prompt: BEFORE compaction: call get_phase_state() and save the result to MEMORY.md (in your auto memory directory). Include: current phase, iteration, key decisions, next steps.

MANDATORY: call get_phase_state() from the MCP server versus-claude to know the current phase of the Iterative Convergence methodology. Then call get_phase_guidance() to get detailed instructions for the current phase. If it returns a project not initialized error, ask the user if they want to start a new project with init_project(). Every important decision must be recorded with record_decision(). Before advancing phases, use get_exit_criteria() and advance_phase().

CONTEXT RESTORED. MANDATORY: call get_phase_state() and get_phase_guidance() to recover methodology state and instructions. Check get_decisions() for previous decisions. Read MEMORY.md (auto memory) for additional context. Continue where you left off.
